metadata.article: ARTICLE 8-4. REQUIRED IMPROVEMENTS, DEDICATIONS, AND FEES
metadata.division: DIVISION 8-4-1. PURPOSE AND APPLICATION OF ARTICLE

content.title: 8-4-1-1. Purpose of article.
content.summary: The purpose of this Article is to set out the required public improvements, dedications, and development-related fees, and to provide a process for waiver, reduction, or deferment of fees in certain cases.

faqs.a: The purpose of this Article is to set out the required public improvements, dedications, and development-related fees, and to provide a process for waiver, reduction, or deferment of fees in certain cases.
